properties.name: IPParameters
properties.comment: UDP/IP parameters. In a Redundancy Scheme, an independent set of these parameters shall be defined for each network interface used.

properties.name: RtpTimestampOffset
properties.comment: RTP timestamp offset. Shall be zero for ST2110-30 senders.

properties.name: TimeSkewMaxTolerated
properties.comment: Maximum tolerated skew. Only used for redundant streams.

properties.name: RemoteEndpointName
properties.comment: External ID of remote endpoint, if any. Remote endpoint name as published on the network.

properties.name: RemoteControlType
properties.comment: Remote endpoint connection management type. Type of control used by remote endpoint.

properties.name: TransmissionCapabilities
properties.comment: Transmission type capability of this Endpoint.

properties.name: PresentationTimeOffset
properties.comment: Presentation Time Offset (called Link Offset in AES67). New in this subclass.

properties.name: MediaInfo
properties.comment: Media information (optional). Application-specific text description of stream.

properties.name: SubmittedSDP
properties.comment: Submitted SDP. SDP string supplied to the most recent call to SubmitSDP().

properties.name: ActiveSDP
properties.comment: Active SDP. SDP string currently in effect for the endpoint.
